Summary: Run exact-revision AI analysis jobs
Description:
## Objective
Provide consent-gated MongoDB asynchronous analysis of one exact owned journal revision through a deterministic backend runtime.

## Scope and dependencies
Backend enabling slice expanded minimally to add the Care-owned `AI_PROCESSING` decision and authorization endpoint. Journal/AI remains Mongo-only and forwards the verified end-user bearer to Care without persisting it. Story 6203 or a dedicated frontend follow-up owns disclosure/consent UI and the visible reflection flow. Story 6204/MB-369 gates real provider selection and official enablement.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Add Care disclosure/decision/authorization contract and backend for `AI_PROCESSING` at `ai-processing-capstone-v1`, independent from `PRIVACY_POLICY`.
- [ ] Add Journal/AI OpenAPI/schema, Mongo migration, unique idempotency, atomic claim, bounded lease recovery, job repository, worker, and provider port without PostgreSQL or Kafka.
- [ ] Enforce consent at request time and before every provider attempt, ownership, idempotency, 30-second timeout, and one allowed retry; fail closed without persisting bearer credentials.
- [ ] Expose owned RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED status/result APIs.
- [ ] Return only approved fields and stable terminal reasons.
- [ ] Exercise success, missing/revoked/unavailable consent, wrong owner, duplicate, lease recovery, timeout, retry, failure, stale revision, and deletion.
- [ ] Use only the deterministic fake provider; retain real OpenAI/Gemini and benchmark work in 6204/MB-369.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] The first confirmation subtask closes only material remaining decisions.
- [ ] The stated actor journey works with persisted owner state and real consumers.
- [ ] Contract, migration, implementation, frontend, and canonical documentation agree where applicable.
- [ ] Proportional tests cover success, authorization, validation, consistency, and dependency failure.
- [ ] Evidence is classified truthfully as fixture browser, service integration, or live cross-stack.

## Evidence
- Care and Journal/AI OpenAPI plus Mongo migration 005 implement the explicit no-PostgreSQL/no-Kafka decision.
- Journal/AI `npm test`: 29/29 pass; `npm run test:integration`: 2/2 pass against migrated MongoDB; format, lint, typecheck, contract, migration, and build gates pass.
- Focused Care disclosure/consent/service/OpenAPI tests pass. The PostgreSQL-backed MockMvc integration scenario is authored but was not executed in this workspace because the Docker engine is unavailable; do not classify this as live cross-stack evidence.
- Storage inspection in the Mongo integration test proves the forwarded bearer, raw provider response, and hidden reasoning are not persisted.

## Completion Notes
Backend implementation completed 2026-09-16. Care exposes the current `AI_PROCESSING` disclosure and `GET /api/v1/consents/ai-processing/authorization`. Journal/AI exposes `POST /api/v1/journals/{journalId}/revisions/{revision}/analysis-jobs` and `GET /api/v1/analysis-jobs/{jobId}` with RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED states, stable consent/auth-context/stale/deleted/provider terminal reasons, `exact-revision-v1` prompt provenance, schema version 1, and the deterministic fake provider. Story 6203 remains responsible for consent/reflection UI; Story 6204/MB-369 remains responsible for real-provider selection and benchmarking.
